column1: # Follow-up probes for #724: Print in failure contexts on the Verse VM.
# followup/print-in-condition (UEFN 43.12 CL 60598086, Verse VM, 2026-11-19 00:02Z) logged
# "(Rolling Back) OVPROBE print-in-condition printed in condition", then "... after": the line of the
# failed condition was printed with the label the Verse VM gives every line of a rolled-back
# transaction (also the lines before a runtime error). These probes ask which lines get the label.
# Run on Epic 2026-11-19 08:43Z (UEFN 43.12 CL 60598086, Verse VM, newVerseVm=true in the ticket):
# all ten logged exactly labelled_lines (epic_outcome ran). The label comes once per Print call: the
# two-line string of print-multiline-in-condition is one labelled entry. A line rolled back by an
# outer context after an inner one kept it carries the label once. Lines appear in program order.
# `ovprobe.py compare` leaves labelled lines out unless --keep-rolled-back.
# openverse_lines: what OpenVerse main (b640fa6d) prints, Lean and C agreeing (it rolls output back).
# labelled_lines: the prediction that the Verse VM echoes a failed context's lines once, labelled, in
# program order. book_*: the Book is silent on Print (its API's `log` class: "If the transaction
# rolls back the lines are still printed, each prefixed with (Rolling Back)").
probe
print-decides-call
column8: A <decides><transacts> callee's Print, in a condition that fails through the call.

column1: print-for-filter
column8: A for filter (a <decides><transacts> call) rejecting the even elements.

column1: print-or-left
column8: The left of `or`, failing then succeeding.

column1: print-option
column8: option{} of a failing then a succeeding call.

column1: print-not
column6: (Rolling Back) operand fails|not succeeded|(Rolling Back) operand succeeds|not failed|after
column8: `not` discards its operand's effects also when the operand succeeds (Book ch. 6): is that line labelled too?

column1: print-nested-contexts
column6: outer one|(Rolling Back) inner one|end one|one passed|(Rolling Back) outer two|(Rolling Back) inner two|(Rolling Back) end two|after
column8: Also: is "inner two" (kept by its call, rolled back by the outer condition) labelled once or twice, and does "(Rolling Back) inner one" come before "outer one" (committed lines held to the outermost commit)?

column1: print-interpolation-effect
column8: An interpolation that calls a printing function, in a failed condition.

column1: print-var-control
column8: Control: the var write is rolled back on every reading.

column1: print-passing-condition
column8: Control: a condition that succeeds; no line may carry the label.

column1: print-multiline-in-condition
column8: The string's second line ("second line") has no marker, so look for it in the raw log right after the labelled line: is it labelled too?
